name: iw3
title: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (IW3)
note: CoD4 (IW3), 32-bit: the Steam iw3mp.exe (1.7) is not encrypted (.text entropy 6.73; iw3sp.exe is SteamStub, 8.00), flattened (file offset == RVA). SP and MP zones share the MP exe's loaders.
rva_note: read off iw3mp.exe: DB_LoadXFileData (dst eax, size ecx) is the file read every loader calls, Load_Stream being inlined into them (0x87680 is its one out-of-line copy: flag [esp+4], dst eax, size esi); DB_InitStreams (eax: the XBlock table, 8 bytes per block); DB_PushStreamPos (ecx) and DB_PopStreamPos, both also inlined: the loaders store the pushed block and call DB_SetStreamIndex (0x87500, [esp+4]) themselves; Load_XStringCustom reads a byte at a time (eax: the field); DB_InsertPointer pushes 4, aligns 4, takes 4 bytes, pops

asset_dispatch.note: Load_XAssetHeader: compares varXAsset->type and calls the type's Load_<T>Ptr with its var set to varXAssetHeader

stream.inline_stream_note: Load_Stream, push and pop are inlined into the loaders: the transcriber reads file_read as the read, folds the block index tests on the pushed block (reading_block 4 where the caller's decides), takes set_block(constant) as a push and set_block(saved) as a pop
stream.null_page_note: the shader loaders test a dvar's field (0x76515: [[0xd560a50] + 0xc]) before creating a D3D shader; the image holds the dvar pointer null
stream.growing_blocks_note: the recording: blocks 4, 7 (vertex) and 8 (index) only grow over all 72 zones; block 0 (temp) is rewound by every pop into it (174 054 reads below its previous end)

release.note: 2026-10-01: 72/72 zones identical (2 737 744 reads); release-check --jobs 3 judged 444 047/444 047 occurrences exact (the sampled count depends on --jobs; check --jobs 4 on all zones: 649 873/649 873)
